purpose: Word pool for the daily game and sınırsız. public/index.html carries a copy as DAILY_POOL.

rules.note: A set is ten words from one family and ten from another. The two families must be easy to tell apart, so a player feels they have ruled out half the grid; the difficulty lives inside a family, where the shapes collide.
rules.why14: A family comes round every 7 days, so a window of 8 to 14 days all cost the same: two fresh batches, 20 words per family. 14 is the top of that band. The next step up is 21, not 15 -- 15 through 21 all cost three batches, 30 words per family, so 15 would pay the full price of 21 and take six fewer days.

families.shape: a rectangle with corners: boxes, screens, books, bags
long and low, wider than tall: vehicles, big animals, furniture
a flowing curve with no corners: clouds, hearts, snakes, body parts
wings out to the sides: birds, insects, and anything that throws two halves wide
a triangle or cone, pointed at the top: hats, mountains, sails
tall and narrow, standing up: poles, bottles, trees, towers
a body with a stalk or handle: cups, jugs, tools you hold
a long thin rod: pens, tools, cutlery, fish
an arc over a base: rainbows, tunnels, shells, bowls
a standing human outline: people, dolls, a skeleton
spokes or rays leaving a centre: fans, flowers, fireworks, wheels
a closed circle: balls, fruit, faces, clock faces
small and egg-shaped: seeds, nuts, pebbles
repeating parallel lines or a grid: fences, barcodes, nets, keyboards
a closed loop with a hole: bracelets, tyres, chains
